technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum and price structure (above all key MAs, new highs, bullish candles) but overbought extremes and weak long-term trend confirmation limit swing entry probability; better suited as continuation trade with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: ARE shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying engagement, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 81 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity (2 small purchases, 1 sale by junior members), neutral market sentiment (AAII bearish-leaning, Fear/Greed at 60), and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 179 crisis regime, FOMC event just passed) creates severe near-term headwinds for real estate despite falling USD and distant earnings event.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (RSI 77.63, Stoch 89.46, three white soldiers with 15x volume spike) and price structure above key moving averages create a technical setup for continuation traders with tight stops.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis regime 179, inverted yield curve, FOMC just passed), zero fundamental support (no insider activity, high earnings risk in 81 days), multiple overbought extremes, and weak long-term trend confirmation (EMA 50/200 false, ADX 25.59) make this a high-risk, low-conviction entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum is strong (RSI 77.63, Stoch 89.46, three white soldiers) but severely undermined by extreme macro headwinds (VIX 179 crisis, inverted yield curve, FOMC just passed) and zero fundamental support with high earnings risk in 81 days.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis regime) will likely trigger sharp pullback from overbought extremes; earnings event in 81 days adds uncertainty without fundamental conviction to justify entry.
